title: HalluciSense — Evidence-Aware Multi-LLM Verification Engine
tagline: Detect AI hallucinations in real-time with statistical NLI rigor and multi-provider evidence consensus.

hero.headline: Stop AI Hallucinations Before They Reach Your Users
hero.subheadline: HalluciSense combines a frozen statistical NLI classifier with parallel multi-LLM consensus to detect ungrounded claims in sub-4ms P95 latency.

features.title: Dual-Pillar Architecture
features.description: Combines ultra-fast frozen statistical NLI (Pillar 1) with multi-provider knowledge graph retrieval and multi-LLM consensus (Pillar 2).

features.title: 8 Benchmark Datasets
features.description: State-of-the-art 0.8920 ROC-AUC across HaluEval, FActScore, TruthfulQA, FEVER, HotpotQA, and XSum.

features.title: Multi-Format Report Export
features.description: Instantly export audit-ready reports in PDF, HTML, Markdown, JSON, and CSV.

features.title: Enterprise API & SDKs
features.description: Integrate in 3 lines of Python or JavaScript with built-in rate-limiting and security headers.
